title: Leia Organa
subtitle: Get to Your Transports!
text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust]: Heal 1 damage from a friendly unit.
deployBox: On Attack: Heal 1 damage from a friendly unit and 1 damage from another friendly unit.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader. (Flip her, ready her, and move her to the ground arena.)
